summary: Comprehensive testing of Scheduled Order feature completed successfully. Backend APIs 100% passing (9/9 tests). Frontend Kitchen Orders page verified with Active/Upcoming tabs and blocking popup for scheduled orders with alert_triggered.
passed_tests: ✅ POST /api/orders with is_scheduled=true creates scheduled order with status='scheduled'
✅ Kitchen alert time 10min for dine-in orders
✅ Kitchen alert time 10min for takeaway orders
✅ Kitchen alert time 20min for delivery orders
✅ POST /api/orders without is_scheduled creates normal orders with status='preparing'
✅ GET /api/orders/scheduled returns all scheduled orders with alert_triggered flag
✅ POST /api/orders/{order_id}/confirm-scheduled changes status to 'preparing' and sets schedule_confirmed=true
✅ Kitchen orders page has Active and Upcoming tabs
✅ Kitchen orders page shows blocking popup for scheduled orders with alert_triggered=true
✅ Blocking popup shows Order ID, Order Type, Ready At time, Customer name, Items with grams
✅ Confirm & Start button in popup works and moves order to active queue
seed_data_creation: Created test scheduled orders for dine-in, takeaway, and delivery types
context_for_next_testing_agent: Scheduled orders feature is fully implemented and working. Backend APIs at /api/orders with is_scheduled=true and /api/orders/scheduled and /api/orders/{id}/confirm-scheduled all functional. Frontend Kitchen Orders page at /kitchen shows Active (immediate orders) and Upcoming (scheduled orders) tabs. Blocking popup appears for scheduled orders when kitchen_alert_time has passed (alert_triggered=true). Kitchen PIN login is 1234.
